answer_1.quote: We select six representative tasks related to spoken language understanding: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), Phoneme Recognition (PR), Keyword Spotting (KS), Emotion Recognition (ER), Spoken Intent Classification (IC), and Speech Translation (ST). ... We evaluate ... using Word Error Rate (WER) for ASR, Phoneme Error Rate (PER) for PR, BLEU score for ST, and accuracy for KS, ER, and IC.
answer_1.outputs: Transcribed text, translated text, intent labels, keyword labels, emotion labels, phoneme sequences
